name: Agriculture
boundaries: Agriculture: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.reason: The capability is retained without requiring nodules or claiming that all synthetic nitrogen use would end.
Perennial rice is acknowledged as an achieved component; the remaining proposal is breadth and competitive performance across major crops and environments.
The transferable carbon-concentrating capability is retained. The historical efficiency and yield figures, including gains with no additional water or nutrients, are not established here.

Covered in part. The programmable, reusable disease-resistance concept is retained. Complete, cost-free protection against every pathogen and insect is not demonstrated or required; insect and nematode protection remain coverage gaps rather than implied results.

Its nitrogen-fixation component is covered by AGR-01, but the historical “no external inputs indefinitely” formulation ignores nutrients removed in harvested products. A microbiome can mobilize or recycle phosphorus but cannot create it; replacement or recovery is still needed where nutrients leave the system. The reviewed phosphorus-cycling literature supports microbial mobilization, not indefinite nutrient creation: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41579-026-01296-w, review abstract. A separately defined, broadly reliable microbiome platform might qualify after further research and a credible nutrient balance.

Resilience to heat, drought, flooding and salinity is important, but “full yield under all simultaneous extremes” does not identify a demonstrated route or a bounded capability beyond an unlimited performance wish. AGR-05 addresses a specific salinity-related system; it does not cover universal climate resilience.
The revised concept focuses on integrated, economically useful autonomy and measurable human oversight, without unsupported zero-labor, zero-compaction or fixed efficiency claims.
The revised concept requires measured additional and durable storage alongside food production and full emissions accounting.
The revised concept includes the essential salt and water balance and does not assume seawater farming ends freshwater competition.
The general capability is retained, without asserting that any plant can become a competitive staple in one or two generations.

reconciliation_change_log.change: AGR-01–AGR-07 retained with their original identities.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The distinction between demonstrated components and the broader proposed capabilities was clarified, and the proposed completion tests were kept separate from published standards.
Reconsidered end-to-end farm autonomy as a potentially transformative integrated capability, including a radical reduction in cost or labor where existing task-specific robots do not suffice.
Retained the historical carbon-storage idea as a distinct food-production capability, without adopting its unsupported numerical rate or treating deeper roots as proof of durable removal.
Universal outcomes, elimination of all fertilizer or pesticides, fixed yield gains without additional resources, and automatic soil-carbon benefits are not established by the cited evidence.
